scripts.actions_portal_minis_ancient_feu: All the players need to be level
scripts.moveevent_drume_entrance.msg_1: You've been into the skirmish in the last 10 hours.
scripts.2_ambassadors_treason.msg_1: Documents were burnt here recently. Only the part of one scroll still lies in front of the chimney but it's too sooted to read.
scripts.2_ambassadors_treason.msg_3: Paper scraps lie scattered on the floor. It takes some time to put them back together. But it's only a badly written poem.
scripts.2_ambassadors_treason.msg_5: You examine the scrolls carefully. Those are orders from Rathleton for the Ambassador. No sign of treason here.
scripts.2_ambassadors_treason.msg_7: You find nothing in the Ambassador's house. If he's in fact a traitor he got rid of any evidence that could incriminate him.
scripts.6_mind_travel.msg_1: You feel shaky and dizzy, the world turns dark around you. Then your sight clears again - and you are somewhere else.
scripts.6_mind_travel.msg_2: You were moved to the right brain side
scripts.6_mind_travel.msg_3: You were moved to the left brain side
